newsitem.title: USA: SurVivaLink defibrillator cleared by FDA.
newsitem.headline: SurVivaLink defibrillator cleared by FDA.

text.p: SurVivaLink Corp, a maker of automated external defibrillators, said Monday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has given clearance to its next generation defibrillator.
The device is designed to be used by emergency personnel, such as paramedics, firefighters and police officers, who are the first to respond to an emergency.
Additional clearance was received for the electrode technology of the device, called FirstSave.

The new device includes one-button, voice prompted operation for ease of use, maintenance free lithium battery with a five year operating life, pre-connected and self-testing electrodes for faster set-up time and reliable operation, the company said.
